title: ICIG hinted to Brown that humans are not in charge

tellings.quote: the ICIG did it >> with me personally I I want to respect them but the ICI did it with me yes

plain: A Pentagon whistleblower named Matthew Brown says that staff at the Intelligence Community Inspector General, the watchdog office that takes complaints from inside the US spy agencies, hinted to him personally that humans are not the ones in charge. Brown tells it as something that happened to him, and says he wants to stay respectful toward the office even as he says "the ICIG did it with me," which would mean the people officially charged with checking the agencies had passed him that idea.
